# Bubble

Displays framed or unframed conversational content with alignment and reactions.

## Installation

Add Bubble from the configured StackTrace registry.

```shell
npx shadcn-vue@latest add @stacktrace/bubble
```

## Usage

Put visible content inside `BubbleContent`. Bubble owns the message surface only; compose it inside [Message](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/components/message) when the row also needs an avatar, sender name, timestamp, or message-level actions.

**Bubble example**

```vue
<template>
  <div class="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-8">
    <Bubble align="end">
      <BubbleContent>Can you review the latest component update?</BubbleContent>
    </Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="muted">
      <BubbleContent>
        Yes. The registry and documentation are both up to date.
      </BubbleContent>
      <BubbleReactions role="img" aria-label="Reaction: thumbs up">
        <span>👍</span>
      </BubbleReactions>
    </Bubble>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  Bubble,
  BubbleContent,
  BubbleReactions,
} from '@/Components/Bubble'
</script>
```

## Variants

Use `default` for the strongest primary surface, `secondary` or `muted` for neutral conversation, `tinted` for subtle primary emphasis, and `outline` for bordered rich content. The `ghost` variant removes the frame and width limit, while `destructive` presents an error or failed action.

**Variants example**

```vue
<template>
  <div class="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-5">
    <Bubble><BubbleContent>Default</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="secondary" align="end"><BubbleContent>Secondary</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="muted"><BubbleContent>Muted</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="tinted" align="end"><BubbleContent>Tinted</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="outline"><BubbleContent>Outline</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="destructive" align="end"><BubbleContent>Destructive</BubbleContent></Bubble>
    <Bubble variant="ghost">
      <BubbleContent>Ghost content is unframed and can span the full row.</BubbleContent>
    </Bubble>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Bubble, BubbleContent } from '@/Components/Bubble'
</script>
```

## Alignment and groups

Set `align="start"` or `align="end"` on the root. When Bubble is inside Message, it follows the Message alignment automatically. `BubbleGroup` stacks consecutive surfaces from the same sender; keep the alignment on each Bubble rather than on the group.

## Reactions

`BubbleReactions` overlaps the top or bottom edge and can align to either side. For read-only emoji, give the row `role="img"` and one descriptive `aria-label`. For interactive reactions, render labeled Buttons instead and leave enough vertical spacing between adjacent bubbles.

## Interactive content

Use `as-child` on `BubbleContent` to apply its styling to a real link or button. The component supplies hover and focus-visible treatments, while the child supplies the correct semantics and behavior.

```vue
<Bubble variant="muted" align="end">
  <BubbleContent as-child>
    <button type="button" @click="reply">Reply to this message</button>
  </BubbleContent>
</Bubble>
```

## Accessibility

Bubble is presentational. Put conversation semantics and live-region behavior on the surrounding message list. Do not distinguish senders or errors by color alone; retain sender text, alignment, icons, or explicit error wording as appropriate.

Hosted documentation: [Bubble](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/components/bubble)
